- [ ] Skim `§0` and `§1` self-check section to verify the bootstrap procedure still matches your VPS layout and current Devin native git proxy behaviour.
- [ ] Scan `§6.4 Next step` for sanity: the suggested `ready` Ticket pool (TKT-007/008/009/011/014/015) and the dispatch pattern reference reflect your intended next-cycle workflow.
- [ ] Confirm the PR-Agent integration claims in `§6.6` (Qwen 3.6 Plus via OmniRoute, replaces Devin Review, heavy-tuned via PR #47) match your understanding before merging — this is the canonical reference a future orchestrator will read.

Test plan: validator already runs in CI (`validate-docs`); merge-conflict-free per local rebase check.

- Naming: `<YYYY-MM-DD>-session-N.md` where N is the session counter for that date (today is 2026-04-30; session-1 + session-2 already exist; this is session-3).
- §6.7 documents the `~/handoff/` files used during this session for future-orchestrator transparency, but explicitly notes they are TKT-006-specific and should NOT be reused for the next Ticket cycle.
